$description: Card (platform/components/Card), the expandable card (library wave 8, lane C): the tokens of its Expand/Collapse button. The card's other tokens are in the shared set (components.tokens.json).

card-toggle-height.$description: Expandable card: the toggle's height (the inline action height; it follows the density).

card-toggle-width.$description: Expandable card: the toggle's width (a square).

card-toggle-radius.$description: Expandable card: the toggle's corners (its hover fill).

card-toggle-hover-background.$description: Expandable card: the toggle's fill under the pointer.

card-toggle-hover-text.$description: Expandable card: the chevron under the pointer.

card-toggle-focus-outline-color.$description: Expandable card: the toggle's focus ring.

card-toggle-focus-outline-offset.$description: Expandable card: the focus ring's offset.

card-toggle-focus-outline-width.$description: Expandable card: the focus ring's width.

card-toggle-icon-duration.$description: Expandable card: how long the chevron takes to turn.

card-toggle-z-index.$description: Expandable card: the toggle sits above the title's target of a card that opens.
